what: runtime probe of a **DiffEq (Mode::Ode)** match: per shot, the sampler arguments (mode/flip/x0/y0/step + the token stream actually fed in), the returned point array (ptr, n, digest, first/last point), and the point the report reads (`pos = pts[n-1]` at execute_results 0x472865). Answers docs/06 25.1's open question (is the replay pos_x the last point of the array the sampler produced?).

how_to_make_an_ode_match.path: campaign: user://campaign.save = "level_20" (unlock all 21) -> Menu "Campaign" -> level node #16 (691,751) -> popup "Start" (1072,1009). Campaign level 16 has func=1 (DiffEq) per docs/10-campaign.md 4 (mode word 0x05030001, bit-exact).
how_to_make_an_ode_match.ui_check: the JoinLevelPopUp shows the `dy/dx =` icon and the play screen prompt reads `dy/dx =` instead of `f(x) =` (screenshots, not committed)

build.address_space: RVA = ELF virtual address = module offset; Ghidra address = RVA + 0x100000

how.driver: tools/frida_ode_probe.py --attach (NOT frida spawn: spawn hangs the game in wait4)
how.probe: tools/frida_ode_probe.js (read-only Interceptor hooks; no memory writes)
how.sampler_abi: 0x3c2530 (out: Vec<(f64,f64)> = rdi, tokens: &TokenBuf{cap,ptr,len} = rsi, flip = edx, MODE = ecx [0=Normal, 1=Ode], x0 = xmm0, y0 = xmm1, step = xmm2). Read off the prologue (3c2541/3c2544/3c254a/3c254c/3c254f/3c2555/3c255a) and the 0x3c25f5 `test %r15b,%r15b` split into two bisection loops.
how.digest: FNV-1a 64 over ALL 16*n bytes (`digest_xy`) and over the y halves only (`digest_y`).
how.positive_control: probe self-test at install: two 100-point synthetic arrays -> same; flip 1 bit at point 37 -> diffPoints=1; flip one more at point 90 -> 2. Also runtime: different (text, constant) gives different arrays.
how.mode_evidence: (1) `ecx` at the sampler entry reads 1 for every shot; (2) the evaluator receives many DISTINCT y arguments (Normal passes y0 once, then 0); (3) the UI shows `dy/dx =`.

cut: per shot: mode/flip/x0/y0/step, the token stream fed to the sampler ({tag, value-bits}), the array the report reads (ptr, n, digest, first/last/second-last point) and the other sampler calls of the same shot, the execute_results queue snapshot, and the 16 bytes read by the `movdqu` (pos_x/pos_y).
dropped: beat rows, whole-array hex, and every evaluator sample except the first few.
no_local_paths: no filesystem path and no user name; pointers are ASLR-random per run.
notes: how the Ode match was made: user://campaign.save = level_20 (all 21 levels unlocked) -> main menu Campaign -> campaign grid node #16 at (691,751) in a 1920x1160 window -> popup Start at (1072,1009). Campaign level 16 is func=1 (DiffEq): docs/10-campaign.md 4, mode word 0x05030001 bit-exact. UI evidence: the JoinLevelPopUp shows the dy/dx icon, the play screen prompt reads 'dy/dx =' instead of 'f(x) ='.

shot 1 is a repeat of shot 0, not a different expression: 'xdotool type -- -y' is needed (without '--' xdotool eats '-y' as an option and types nothing), so the previous text stayed in the box. Evidence: identical token stream ([VarY]) and identical digest_xy.

mode is read off the sampler entry (ecx of 0x3c2530, 0=Normal 1=Ode), not inferred from the shape: 22/22 calls read 1. The evaluator argument y also takes many distinct values inside one shot (RK4 stages), which Normal never does.

stop reason per shot: 10/11 ended at the board boundary (|x| -> 25 four times, |y| -> 15 six times); shot 10 (sqrt(0-y)) ended by NaN once the integrated y crossed 0. No shot hit the 20000-point budget or the 100-iteration non-convergence branch.

end_x is recorded as equal to pos_x on purpose: docs/06 27/40.5/43 established that FunctionPoints.end_x and EffectInfo(Explosion).pos_x are the same reading (pts[n-1]) at 0x472865. This round hooks only that one reading, so end_x here is not an independent observation.

the two sampler calls of one shot receive x0 values that differ by exactly 1 ulp (hex ...02 vs ...03 in every one of the 11 shots); their arrays therefore differ (digest_xy differs, 11/11). In Normal mode (docs/06 43) the same two calls were bitwise identical - this is a DiffEq-only observation.

repro was produced by examples/ode_array_check: it re-runs the kernel graphwar_path_calculator::calculate with the captured (tokens, x0, y0, step, flip, mode) and memcmp's all 16*n bytes against the captured array; the verdict fields in each shot row come from there.
